comments.text: Ottomans should not be representative of Turks anymore, they are a just a family that's become more European than Turkish in the last 2 centuries, not to mention the very same dynasty abandoned Turks to their own devices when Brits invaded Istanbul. (Well, the Sultan even tried to stop our independence war but thankfully failed as a late Ottoman tradition) The tomb obviously is a cultural heritage and has historical significance etc but military intervention to protect it? It's a bit extreme. Especially considering that Turkiye has a very lousy and sloppy approach to preserve the most important historic sites in human history which reside in Anatolia and our mediterannean costs, the remains of Roman Empire that are ghosted by the busy city life in Istanbul, etc.  etc. so this kinda seems like Turkiye has another agenda to keep her influence in the Syrian land one way or another.
